sourceCitation: Standard ABO/Rh compatibility relationships as commonly described in transfusion-medicine teaching material. NOT independently reviewed for this project.
disclaimer: LifeLink uses these relationships only to narrow operational matching. They are NOT a clinical authority. No qualified professional has reviewed this table for this deployment. Compatibility, crossmatching and release decisions must be made by qualified personnel using validated laboratory procedures.
notes: Red-cell direction: a recipient may receive from the listed donor groups.
Plasma direction is the inverse of red cells and is encoded separately.
Platelets are listed conservatively; ABO-identical is preferred in practice and the engine flags non-identical platelet matches for review.
Whole blood requires ABO/Rh identical units.
An Rh-negative recipient is never listed as able to receive Rh-positive red cells.
Any combination absent from this table resolves to UNKNOWN, never to COMPATIBLE.
